right_single_endpoint_per_digit_incompat.source_level_reason: At each NOTE_ON, stance=1 and that digit uses the same q_contact regardless of pitch; a5-digit fixed contact map cannot supply9 distinct inner-key contact targets over the phrase. A new key/hand-position-conditioned posture mechanism is required.

left_pitch_context.source_level_reason: Changing event IDs or input pitches leaves the inherited target poses/root tied to D2/D3; there is no qualified three-contact left task or moving-register control.

adaptation_assessment: Requires a new target-key/hand-position-conditioned pose mechanism, coordinated left chord generation, and long-phrase hand-position/fingering organization; not just widening the event loop or copying the existing coefficients. Implementing and qualifying that unestablished core in this product-validation round would exceed a limited reuse adapter.
